items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I went straight from Teddy Hill to John Kirby... Kirby was looking for someone to play Maxine's music... my entrance into the band you might say was to play Maxine's music.

ctx.x: I guess it was right on to Kirby.
From Teddy Hill, yes. Yes. I went straight from Teddy Hill to John Kirby. What time is it?
